runbooks.title: Raise pool + restart payments-svc
steps: Confirm pool exhaustion - active connections on payments-db sit at max_pool_size and payments-svc logs "timeout acquiring connection".
Set max_pool_size in services/payments-db/config.yaml back to the last known good value (200) and apply it.
Restart payments-svc one pod at a time so every pod reconnects with the new pool size.
Watch checkout-api error rate return under 1% for 10 minutes.

runbooks.title: Fail over payments-db to the standby
steps: Check replication lag on the payments-db standby is under 1 second.
Promote the standby with the failover script and repoint the payments-db DNS record.
Restart payments-svc so it drops connections to the old primary.
Rebuild the old primary as the new standby.
